# Why did my Zoho CRM import go wrong?

> Catch what breaks a Zoho CRM leads, contacts, accounts or deals import, with the line number, before you upload. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
